changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS users_device_type_check; ALTER TABLE users DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS users_app_type_check;

changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.sql: UPDATE users SET device_type = UPPER(device_type) WHERE device_type IS NOT NULL; UPDATE users SET app_type = UPPER(app_type) WHERE app_type IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT users_device_type_check CHECK (device_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['ANDROID'::character varying, 'IOS'::character varying, 'WEB'::character varying]::text[]));

changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT users_app_type_check CHECK (app_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['HQADMIN'::character varying, 'CASHIER'::character varying, 'WAITER'::character varying, 'MANAGER'::character varying, 'KDS'::character varying]::text[]));
